name: apppilot
description: Physical app operations through discovered transports and platform executors.

interface.shortDescription: Build and operate apps through physical execution transports
interface.longDescription: AppPilot discovers an available physical execution transport and platform executor, then performs build, install, lifecycle, input, and log operations through its CLI.
defaultPrompt: Discover an execution target and launch the app.
Build and install an app for a selected platform.
